MASTER DATA SERVICES AGREEMENT

Vendor: Northstar Data Cooperative LLC
Customer: Example Analytics Holdings Inc.

TERM
This Agreement is effective on January 1, 2025 and expires on December 31, 2027. It automatically renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives 90 days written notice.

PERMITTED USE
Customer may use the supplied records for audience measurement and internal analytics.

TERMINATION
Either party may terminate for a material breach that remains uncured for 30 days after written notice.

DELIVERY AND COMMERCIAL TERMS

Vendor will deliver a complete data file every Monday by 06:00 UTC.

Customer commits to an annual purchase minimum of USD 240,000.

If Vendor misses three scheduled deliveries in a calendar quarter, Customer receives a service credit equal to 5% of that quarter's fees. Amounts unpaid by Customer more than 30 days after notice accrue interest at 1% per month.

STATEMENT OF WORK 24-B

Supplier: Blue Heron Signals Ltd.
Effective Date: March 15, 2025
End Date: March 14, 2026

This Statement of Work does not renew automatically.

SCOPE
Supplier will provide anonymized household movement aggregates for Customer's fraud detection and internal analytics programs.

DELIVERY SERVICE LEVEL

Daily incremental files must arrive between 02:00 UTC and 04:00 UTC. A full refresh must arrive by 08:00 UTC each Sunday.

There is no annual spending minimum under this Statement of Work.

TERMINATION
Customer may terminate for convenience on 45 days written notice. Either party may terminate immediately for unlawful use of the data.

SERVICE CREDITS

For each daily file delivered after 04:00 UTC, Supplier will credit USD 500, capped at USD 5,000 per month.

Customer must delete all supplied records within 10 business days after termination. Failure to certify deletion results in a USD 2,500 administrative charge.

SECOND ADDENDUM TO MASTER DATA SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Second Addendum is entered into by Northstar Data Cooperative LLC and Example Analytics Holdings Inc. and is effective October 1, 2027.

AMENDED EXPIRATION DATE
The expiration date in the Agreement is deleted and replaced with June 30, 2029. For avoidance of doubt, December 31, 2027 is no longer the expiration date.

AMENDED RENEWAL AND DELIVERY

After June 30, 2029, the Agreement automatically renews for successive six-month terms unless either party gives 120 days written notice.

The weekly delivery deadline is changed to every Tuesday by 05:00 UTC.

All other provisions, including permitted uses, termination rights, annual minimums, and penalties, remain unchanged.

INFORMATION LICENSE

PARTIES
Licensor: Cedar Peak Information Partners Inc.
Licensee: Example Commerce Group LLC

WHEN THIS LICENSE APPLIES
Commencement: 2026-07-01
Sunset: 2028-06-30
Continuation: The license rolls over for one additional year unless notice is received at least 60 days before Sunset.

WHAT LICENSEE MAY DO

Licensee may use the information to improve address quality, suppress duplicate customer records, and conduct internal market research. Advertising resale and consumer eligibility decisions are prohibited.

ENDING THE RELATIONSHIP
A party may end this license after an uncured material default by giving 20 business days to cure.

OPERATING COMMITMENTS

A replacement snapshot will be available no later than the fifth business day of each month.

The yearly committed fee floor is USD 75,000.

If Licensor is late, 2% of the monthly fee is credited for each business day of delay, up to 10%. If Licensee exceeds the permitted user count, Licensee pays USD 100 per excess user per month.

Provider: Lantern Lake Taxonomy Services LLC

Authorized purposes are product categorization and search relevance tuning.

TABLE 1 - DELIVERY FILES

File                    Cadence       Deadline
category_full.csv       Monthly       3rd business day, 12:00 UTC
category_delta.csv      Weekly        Friday, 18:00 UTC
value_dictionary.csv    Quarterly     10th calendar day, 12:00 UTC

Annual record-volume minimum: 25 million records.

TABLE 2 - TAXONOMY COLUMNS

Column                  Meaning                     Example
CATEGORY_ID             Stable category key         C-1042
PARENT_CATEGORY_ID      Parent category key         C-1000

Provider must announce breaking taxonomy changes 30 days before delivery.

REMEDIES AND TERMINATION

LIMITED DATA LICENSE

Vendor Legal Name: Meadowlark Consumer Insights LLC
Effective: April 1, 2026
Expires: March 31, 2029
Renewal: successive one-year periods; opt-out notice is due 90 days before expiration.

SECTION 4 - PERMITTED USES

Customer may use the licensed data solely for:
  1. internal market research;
  2. aggregate audience segmentation;
  3. suppression of existing customers from acquisition campaigns; and
  4. measurement of advertising reach.

Customer may not use the data for credit, employment, insurance, or housing eligibility decisions.

OPERATIONS AND TERMINATION

Vendor delivers weekly files each Wednesday between 01:00 and 03:00 UTC. Annual minimum: USD 125,000.

Either party may terminate for breach after a 25-day cure period. Vendor credits 3% of monthly charges per late file, capped at 12%. Customer pays USD 50,000 for a substantiated prohibited eligibility use.

DATA SUPPLY AGREEMENT

Supplier: Red Maple Geo Products Inc.
Start Date: 2025-08-20
End Date: 2027-08-19
Renewal: This Agreement will not renew automatically.

Data may be used for route optimization and internal site-selection analysis.

DELIVERY AND EXIT

A full geographic file is due on the 15th calendar day of each month by 17:00 UTC.

Either party may terminate for an uncured material breach after 30 days written notice. Customer may also terminate if four deliveries are late in any twelve-month period.

There is no annual purchase minimum.

MUTUAL REMEDIES

SUPPLIER FAILURE. For a file delivered more than 24 hours late, Supplier pays Customer USD 2,000 per occurrence. For corrupted geometry affecting more than 1% of records, Supplier pays an additional USD 7,500.

CUSTOMER FAILURE. If Customer redistributes raw coordinates, Customer pays Supplier USD 100,000 per incident. If Customer is more than 45 days late paying an invoice, Customer pays 1.25% interest per month.

ENTERPRISE DATA PRODUCTS AGREEMENT

Vendor: Juniper Ridge Data Works LLC
Customer: Example Retail Systems Corp.
Effective Date: May 5, 2025
Expiration Date: May 4, 2028
Renewal: automatic one-year renewals unless either party provides 120 days notice.

GENERAL TERMS

The parties agree that confidentiality, security, audit, and data-handling obligations apply to every Product listed in an Exhibit. Defined terms have the meanings stated in this Agreement.

PERMITTED USE

Customer may use Products for internal demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and aggregate location analytics. Customer may not sell raw records or use a Product to make an individual eligibility decision.

DELIVERY

Daily deltas are due by 05:30 UTC. Weekly full files are due each Sunday by 10:00 UTC. Quarterly dictionaries are due within five business days after quarter end.

FEES

The annual committed minimum is USD 600,000 across all Products. Unused committed amounts expire at the end of each contract year.

SERVICE LEVEL REMEDY

If Vendor misses a daily deadline by more than six hours, Vendor credits 1% of the monthly Product fee per occurrence, capped at 15% per month.

CUSTOMER REMEDY

If Customer discloses raw records to an unauthorized third party, Customer must pay USD 80,000 per event in addition to documented remediation costs.

TERMINATION

Either party may terminate for a material breach not cured within 30 days. Customer may terminate a Product Exhibit after five missed delivery deadlines in a rolling six-month period without terminating this Agreement.

EXHIBIT A - POWER PRODUCT

Asset: Grid Pulse Daily
Coverage: national aggregate load zones
Delivery: daily delta and Sunday full file
Dictionary version: GP-4.2

EXHIBIT B - IDENTITY PRODUCT

Asset: Household Link Reference
Coverage: pseudonymous household clusters
Delivery: weekly full file
Dictionary version: HLR-7.1

EXHIBIT C - DICTIONARY

Field                   Type          Meaning
PRODUCT_ID              STRING        Stable product identifier
OBSERVATION_DATE         DATE          UTC observation date
REGION_CODE             STRING        Aggregate region identifier
VALUE                    NUMBER        Reported aggregate value

EXHIBIT D - CONTACTS AND NOTICES

Operational notices: operations@example.invalid
Legal notices: legal@example.invalid
Billing notices: billing@example.invalid

END OF AGREEMENT
